title: Account Manager - Marketplace
description:
At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.

In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. We are conscientious that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’.

Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day 1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities, to be launched in 2022.

Are you looking for a challenging career? Are you adaptable, curious, and persistent to achieve great results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? The Amazon team is looking for New Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Your role will be focused on contributing to new acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting and recruiting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing, and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their presence on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems, and tools. Lastly, you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems, and tools.

Your Responsibilities

  1. Identify, prospect, and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email.
  2. Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets.
  3. Be a partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon.
  4. Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience.
  5. Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory, and performance efficiently and to the required standards.
  6. Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items, and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants.
  7. Track and report development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants.
  8. Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies.
  • Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools.
  • Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals.

Somos uma empresa em crescimento no setor de EdTech, focada em transformar a educação por meio de tecnologia e inovação. Nosso propósito é ajudar estudantes de todo o Brasil a alcançar seus objetivos educacionais, e estamos em busca de profissionais talentosos e apaixonados para se juntar à nossa equipe.

Cargo: Corretor de Redação - Remoto

Missão: A missão do corretor de redação é revisar e avaliar redações de acordo com critérios predeterminados, fornecendo feedback construtivo para ajudar os alunos a melhorarem suas habilidades de escrita. O corretor de redação desempenha um papel fundamental no desenvolvimento das competências de comunicação escrita dos estudantes, fornecendo orientações para que eles possam expressar suas ideias de forma clara e coerente. Além disso, é o profissional responsável por alavancar a nota do aluno em uma das principais provas do Enem: a redação. A nota na redação do Enem é determinante para que o aluno conquiste a tão sonhada vaga no curso almejado. Sendo assim, o corretor de redação é um dos catalisadores dos sonhos dos estudantes, que deverá, com empatia e paciência, auxiliar os alunos nessa árdua jornada rumo à aprovação.

O que esperamos de você aqui?

  1. Fácil adaptação à nossa ferramenta automatizada de correção.
  2. Correção com comentários claros, objetivos e direcionados.
  3. Realização do trabalho com paciência e empatia, sempre mantendo a linguagem adequada ao nosso público-alvo.
  4. Abertura para receber e oferecer feedbacks construtivos.
  5. Capacidade clara de organização e de comunicação.

Atribuições da função:

  1. Realizar correções on-line de redações em plataforma automatizada, nos modelos Enem e vestibulares, com indicação de nota e comentários para que o aluno melhore o seu desempenho na escrita.
  2. Manter a qualidade nas correções.

Requisitos da função:

  1. Graduação completa em Letras Português ou Linguística.
  2. Experiência em correções nos modelos Enem e vestibulares.
  3. Conhecimento aprofundado da norma-padrão da língua portuguesa.
  4. Habilidades de comunicação escrita: ser capaz de expressar ideias e conceitos de forma clara, organizada e concisa, adaptando o tom da escrita às necessidades do público-alvo.
  5. Habilidade analítica: ter habilidade para analisar e avaliar textos de forma imparcial, identificando erros, inconsistências e áreas de melhoria.
  6. Empatia e paciência: estas são características fundamentais para os nossos corretores, que vão ajudar os alunos a atingirem seu potencial.

Detalhes sobre a função:

  1. Regime de contratação autônomo.
  2. Carga horária flexível. Você faz o seu horário!
  3. Trabalhe de qualquer lugar e em qualquer dia da semana!
  4. Ferramenta intuitiva: preparamos o sistema para que você corrija de maneira ágil e eficaz.

Habilidades técnicas:

  1. Língua Portuguesa;
  2. Linguagens;
  3. Revisão de textos;
  4. Gramática;
  5. Conhecimento ENEM;
  6. Conhecimento Pré Vestibulares;
  7. Ambiente virtual.

Lead Account Manager – Iraq

Working knowledge of business and financial fundamentals (Profit & Loss, Investment Analysis, Balance Sheet, Green Sheets).

  1. Colaborar com PM e engenheiros de software para definir e implementar soluções consistentes, interfaces atrativas e com experiência fluída e acessível.
  2. Executar todas as etapas de design, desde o discovery até a entrega final para a engenharia.

  7. Desenvolver novos conceitos de produtos e fornecer soluções de design que equilibrem as necessidades dos usuários, os objetivos de negócios e a viabilidade tecnológica.
  8. Aplicar método para desenvolvimento contínuo dos produtos, contemplando análises, reports e plano de ação para evolução da solução, com o objetivo de garantir a melhor experiência para o usuário.
  9. Fazer documentação adequada de suas atividades e artefatos.

Requisitos

  1. Proficiência em ferramentas de design como Figma e pacote Adobe para prototipação navegável em alta fidelidade e criação de artefatos diversos.

  3. Proficiência em ferramentas e métodos de pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa.
  4. Experiência com princípios de acessibilidade em design.
  5. Experiência sólida em criar wireframes, storyboards, fluxos de usuário, fluxos de processos e mapas de site.
  6. Portfólio robusto demonstrando trabalhos de design de produto de alta qualidade.
  7. Experiência com metodologias de design centrado no usuário.
  8. Experiência prática utilizando design system.
  9. Habilidade para fazer a adequada documentação dos entregáveis.
  10. Excelente comunicação e habilidades de colaboração.
  11. Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de pensar estrategicamente.
  12. Orientação para detalhes com um olhar aguçado para estética e detalhes visuais.
  13. Fortes habilidades interpessoais e capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe.
  14. Adaptabilidade e abertura para feedback.
  15. Atitude proativa e capacidade de tomar iniciativa.
  16. Habilidade de influência para contribuir com a cultura de design.

description:
Miratech helps visionaries to change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together global enterprise innovation and start-up innovation. Today we support digital transformation for the largest enterprises on the planet. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. Our culture of Relentless Performance enables over 99% of Miratech’s engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech operates in over 25 countries including Canada, Cyprus, Finland, Germany, India, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK, Ukraine, and the US. Miratech employs 800+ people and Miratech’s sales CAGR exceeds 30%.

Job Description

Scrum Master takes on various roles based on the maturity level of the Agile team. Clearly, the success of any Agile team is based on the effective partnership of the Scrum Master and the team, collaborating, and embracing Agile principles. As a Scrum Master, you naturally have a servant leader and coach mindset. You will identify needs, remove impediments, and contribute as necessary to ensure the performance and success of the team. This position requires a leader accountable for maximizing the business value produced by the team, including throughput and delivery.

Responsibilities:

  1. Lead multiple global cross-functional teams on various projects by using Agile methodology (Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe).
  2. Sprint Events: Effectively manage and facilitate sprint ceremonies to support development and product releases.
  3. Product Shaping/Scope Management: Support the product owner and provide education where needed especially in Product Backlog health, Dependency Management to better manage Releases.
  4. Stakeholder Management: Partner, collaborate, and manage team stakeholders, vendors, and dependent teams.
  5. PI and Sprint Planning: Help the teams to accomplish Sprint goals & PI OKRs by following ceremonies and planning/estimation of epics in Agile tools. Lead planning increment sessions to establish scope and build release plans.
  6. Coaching Teams: Coach squads in self-organization. Help the squads achieve higher levels of Agile maturity.
  7. Impediment Management: Tactically identify dependencies and blockers, track and help remove them accordingly.
  8. Retrospective: Ability to identify pain points for Agile teams and bring in fresh practical ideas.
  9. Progress tracking and Metrics: Setup and review metrics to drive progress. Note anti-agile patterns through metrics and coach/steer teams accordingly. Escalate if progress is hindered.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college/university.
  2. 4+ years of experience in building data platforms and solutions.
  3. 5+ years leading large-scale transformation programs (leveraging Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)), involving business process and change, organization change, and multiple large-scale technology components.
  4. Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Certified Scrum Professional (CSP).
  5. Experience in coaching Product owners in Product backlog health, prioritization, etc.
  6. Very strong understanding of the system development life cycle.

Additional Information

We offer

  1. Culture of relentless performance : join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  2. Competitive pay and benefits : enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
  3. ForeverRemote work culture : make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  4. Growth mindset : reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  5. Global impact : collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  6. Welcoming multicultural environment : be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  7. Social sustainability values : join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

Location: Brazil (remote)
Gaming Laboratories International (GLI) is seeking a bilingual Government Relations and Business Development Executive to join our Client Services team.
Who We Are…
Wherever there is legalized gambling, jurisdictions have a set of regulations by which manufacturers and operators must adhere to. Any game or system which is released to the public must be able to show that it conforms to the required regulations. To do this, the game or system must be tested. This is where we come in. Since 1989, Gaming Laboratories International (GLI) has been the global leader in the testing and certification of gaming devices and systems. We are proud of our stability and our history of world-class customer service delivery to jurisdictions worldwide.
Why You Should Work Here…
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, which is why they are our biggest investment. We offer competitive salaries, top-notch benefits, and a company culture focused on employee development. In addition, you will have an opportunity to collaborate with our global team and utilize problem-solving skills to support cross-functional initiatives and drive efficiency.
What You Will Accomplish Here…
As a Government Relations and Business Development Executive in our Client Services Department, you will be able to leverage your natural ability to harness relationships with clients in a diverse and challenging business climate. Our customers are manufacturers, regulators, and operators within the Gambling industry. Your primary development region will be in Brazil, but support could be required for additional LatAm or Caribbean countries as needed.
We are seeking a professional like you to support our clients’ needs by executing strategic sales plans and delivering results. This is a customer service/sales-focused position and a fit for someone who thrives on driving sales and helping clients solve problems. You will consult directly with clients to identify their needs and provide viable, efficient solutions resulting in high levels of client trust and lasting relationships. This position would focus on fostering new business with new clients and maintaining business relationships with assigned existing clients.
Duties And Responsibilities

  • Responsible for providing world-class customer service throughout the sales lifecycle - from lead generation through to needs analysis, to contract signing, and post-service follow-ups for the achievement of customer satisfaction.
  • Regularly connects (remotely and in-person) with new and existing customers.
  • Build relationships with assigned clients by acting as a primary point of contact.
  • Actively identifies and pursues new business opportunities with potential clients.
  • Develops tailored strategies to meet each client’s goals, identifies upselling and cross-selling opportunities to increase our market share.
  • Grows business with these existing clients by identifying solutions and services to aid their expansion efforts in order to achieve year-on-year sales.
  • Meets or exceeds sales targets and revenue goals by proactively managing pipelines and forecasts.
  • Manages contracts, contract renewals, and participates in negotiations and pricing discussions to align with both client and company objectives.
  • Responsible for project management with close interaction with the internal departments to secure customer satisfaction and client success.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of gaming regulations, processes, and procedures
  • Completes research on legislation and newspaper articles daily that has any effect or impact on gaming, lottery, and voting testing, and accurately relays an analysis of the impact on the Company to the appropriate personnel.
  • Reviews market analysis to determine customer needs.
  • Mains contact between client and the training coordinator for in-service training classes both in GLI offices and at client locations.
  • Completes translations, as assigned.
  • Regularly and consistently updates the CRM system for all assigned customers.
  • Works closely with internal cross functional teams in support of sales strategies and initiatives.
  • Participates, as assigned, in tradeshows, conferences and roundtables.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
How You Will Be Successful…
  • You will be driven and open to sales feedback.
  • You will be diligent, communicative, and collaborative.
  • You will know who your audience is and what your deliverables are.
  • You will exercise good judgement that is in the best interest of the Company.
  • You will be open minded to new processes and adaptable to change.
  • You will model behaviors consistent with the Company’s values.
Education, Experience And Skills
  • A minimum of three (3) years of experience working in a previous sales/development/governmentrole is required.
  • A minimum of two (2) years of experience working in the gaming industry is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Sales, or a related field is preferred, but not mandatory.
  • Must have experience creating and delivering convincing presentations to senior-level clients.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Excel.
  • Must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in collaborative decision-making across technology, sales, and customer teams.
  • Must have the ability to handle multiple projects under tight deadlines, while maintaining a realistic balance among priorities.
  • Must demonstrate a high degree of attention to quality, detail, and accuracy.
  • Must have the ability to read, write, speak, understand, and communicate in English and Brazilian Portuguese sufficiently to perform the duties of this position.
  • Fluency in Spanish as a third language is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Must have the ability to work non-traditional hours, including weekends and holidays and extended hours beyond the traditional workweek, as needed.
Location: Remote (must be in Brazil)
Salary: This will be updated depending on the location.
Travel: Must be willing to travel up to 50%, including occasionally on short notice.
Gaming Laboratories International (GLI) is a gaming services company. Any of our employees may be required to obtain a gaming license within one or all of the gaming jurisdictions. If you are requested by GLI to obtain a gaming license, your continued employment may be contingent on your ability to obtain that gaming license.

description:
A Creditas é uma plataforma de serviços financeiros que a partir da casa, carro e salário oferece empréstimos, seguros e investimentos. Nosso time de Ciência de Dados:

Você é uma pessoa que adora dados e é apaixonada por inovação? Aqui na Creditas ser Cientista de Dados é participar de um grupo focado em trazer soluções que melhorem o negócio através de dados, utilizando estatística e machine learning.Buscamos sempre encontrar a melhor forma de compreender os dados que impulsionam a companhia, entendendo a melhor aplicação dos mesmos e garantindo a assertividade na tomada de decisão.

Quais são as responsabilidades desta vaga:

  • Realizar análises exploratórias em conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões, tendências e insights relevantes para o negócio;
  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente os modelos para garantir precisão e eficiência;
  • Preparar e limpar dados para serem utilizados nos modelos, garantindo sua qualidade e integridade;
  • Criar visualizações e relatórios para comunicar os resultados das análises de forma clara e concisa;

  • Realizar testes e validações para garantir a precisão e robustez dos modelos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros, desenvolvedores e pessoas de negócio para integrar os modelos nas plataformas da empresa;
  • Coletar, analisar e acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos em produção para avaliar a performance, identificando possíveis problemas ou necessidades de ajuste;
  • Demonstrar proatividade e iniciativa para propor novas ideias e soluções para os desafios do time.

Precisamos de alguém com :

  • Experiência prática em modelagem estatística e de machine learning;
  • Experiência em manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e uso de técnicas estatísticas e de machine learning;

  • Disponibilidade para trabalho híbrido: É necessário comparecer ao nosso escritório na região do Morumbi, próximo a estação de trem, em São Paulo, uma vez por mês, durante 4 dias consecutivos, sempre na primeira semana de cada mês (Creditas in Person).

Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente diverso e com equidade de oportunidades. Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as diferenças, elas nos tornam mais fortes.

Promover a diversidade impacta positivamente a jornada de cada cliente. Desenvolvemos nossa flexibilidade cognitiva para resolver problemas, gerar valor e criar soluções mais inovadoras.

description:
Direct message the job poster from SGF Global

Talent Acquisition Manager | Executive Search | Tech Recruiter | International Headhunter | Career Consultant | International Behavioral Analyst

The Challenge:

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Client’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

Our site is evolving on a day-to-day basis and as an SEO team we are focused on unlocking further traffic growth opportunities and aligning content strategy to customer intent. We are also equally up to the task of getting into the details by digging deep into the data and crafting insights that help internal partners shape web journeys and campaigns. Making Client.com a world-class experience for all site visitors – across the entire customer journey.

The SEO Manager for Brazil will be responsible for identifying key opportunities, based on data, using this to craft and promote impactful, locally relevant customer experiences on Client.com in alignment with strategic goals.

About you:

We are looking for someone with a solid grasp of SEO methodologies, ranking strategies, and a passion to stay on top of trends. The ideal candidate is data-driven and a good communicator who can translate data and insight into detailed recommendations. The person is self-motivated and feels comfortable prioritizing multiple projects, with multiple remote teams simultaneously.

Ways of working:

Having gained a deep understanding of the SEO strategy and SEO team operating process, you will find opportunities to improve the SEO performance in Brazil by implementing local optimizations, while aligning with our corporate partners on the global SEO strategy.

This role will also be working alongside Product Managers, unlocking new partnerships and driving value through delivering SEO improvements and clearly measuring the impact of their SEO initiatives.

This position is part of a well-established SEO team, continually bringing in new opportunities, and working with multiple teams cross-functionally to drive our Marketing efforts.

What you’ll do:

  • Monitor SEO performance on Client.com with a core focus on the Brazil market and ensure alignment with the global SEO strategy
  • Plan and implement the SEO roadmap for Brazil, prioritizing initiatives based on impact and clearly measuring outcomes to drive SEO traffic growth
  • Conduct keyword research, content and competitor analysis to better optimize existing content, identify gaps, drive new traffic opportunities and to influence the overall strategy across Client.com
  • Support the team in the weekly and quarterly reporting and communication of SEO health in relation to performance, search trends, providing relevant insights.
  • Transform requirements into briefs and documentation to support the development and execution of optimization and test activities
  • Collaborate with our vendors and handle agency relationships
  • Analyze the Client.com website to provide recommendations for search engine improvements in priority markets to identify new opportunities and support the wider strategy

Key requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese
  • 4+ years SEO experience leading and delivering SEO projects to the highest standards
  • Experience in providing keyword research, forecasts, and performance reports around core SEO metrics, including keyword rankings and traffic
  • Solid understanding of SEO analytics and ability to answer data-related questions both in support of performance reporting and hypothesis definition
  • Proficient in using SEO tools and familiarity with various third-party SEO solutions
  • Excellent interpersonal and partner management skills
  • Ability to handle multiple simultaneous projects

Client is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

At Client, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Client's the place for you.

Juntos, nossos times desenvolvem projetos excepcionais, guiados por valores que mantém nossa sinergia:

  • Respeito e empatia com todos : nosso time é plural e, por isso, o respeito está sempre em primeiro lugar. Temos diversidade por aqui e ela é vivenciada com muita liberdade.

Requirements and skills

Contratamos profissionais de todos os níveis de carreira - Estágio, Júnior, Pleno ou Sênior.

  • Frontend: cuida de nossos sites desktop e mobile. React, Sass, REST, GraphQL, CSS Modules são alguns recursos utilizados. Usabilidade, com código otimizado e performático é o foco.
  • Backend: API, SQL, DevOps, Go, Python, Linux, PHP e GraphQL são alguns recursos que os times utilizam. Performance e otimização são as palavras-chaves!
  • Mobile: programação nativa para Android e iOS. O desenvolvimento é feito em Kotlin, Java e Swift. Utilizamos o Github para controle de versão.

Mas em nossos times de tecnologia há outras áreas de atuação, como testes e projetos.

title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA)
description:
Job Summary

Our activities in Latin America are expanding and Medpace is seeking to add Experienced CRAs to our growing team in Brazil! The Clinical Research Associate at Medpace is offering the unique opportunity to have an exciting career in the research of drug and medical device development. For those with medical and/or health/life science interest and background who want to explore the research field, travel throughout Brazil , and be part of a team bringing pharmaceutical and medical devices to market - this could be the right opportunity for you!

Our successful Clinical Research Associates possess varied backgrounds in medical and other science-related healthcare fields.

PACE – MEDPACE CRA TRAINING PROGRAM

Medpace provides comprehensive initial and ongoing training, unmatched by other CROs. Through our PACE Training Program, you will join other P rofessionals A chieving C RA E xcellence:

  • PACE provides the platform to effectively and confidently carry out your duties, enhance your current abilities and ultimately help you become a high-functioning independent Medpace CRA.
  • PACE will prepare you by developing your CRA skills through interactive discussions and hands-on job-related exercises and practicums.
  • To supplement your in-house and field-based training you may also participate in other clinical research departmental core rotations, learning other aspects of the drug/device development and approval process.

UNEXPECTED REWARDS

This role will allow you to make a difference on a large scale through the enhancement of pharmaceuticals and medical devices. The CRA position provides many other distinctive advantages including:

  • Dynamic working environment, with varying responsibilities day-to-day;
  • Expansive experience in multiple therapeutic areas;
  • Work within a team of therapeutic and regulatory experts;
  • Defined CRA promotion and growth ladder with potential for mentoring and management advancements;
  • Competitive pay and opportunity for significant travel bonus.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
  • Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
  • Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
  • Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
  • Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
  • Regulatory document review;
  • Investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
  • Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
  • Assessing the clinical research site’s patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
  • Completion of monitoring reports and follow-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies, and recommended actions to secure compliance.

Qualifications

***We kindly ask that you submit your application in English***

  • Bachelor's degree in a health or science related field is required;
  • 2-5 years of experience in clinical monitoring preferred;
  • Proven track record of demonstrating experience in clinical patient management, protocol, CRF, preparing of ISF and reconciling TMF documentation; and
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of a team dedicated to supporting the development of ground-breaking drugs and devices. Our employees provide hope for those living with debilitating diseases. We invite you to be a part of something that is impacting millions of people around the globe while enjoying a competitive total compensation and benefits package and internal growth opportunities.

Organic Growth: Medpace is continuing to grow in all areas globally and has built an expansive research campus at its headquarters in Cincinnati, OH. In 2020, Medpace opened a new seven-story building that is approximately 250,000 SQFT. In total, the headquarters' campus includes five buildings and approximately 600,000 SQFT. The company also has expanding office locations in Dallas, TX and Denver, CO.

  • Official Sponsor of FC Cincinnati
  • Hybrid work-from-home options and flexible work schedule
  • On-site Market Place

  • On campus restaurants and banks coming soon

Awards:

  • Medpace historically named a Top Cincinnati Workplace by the Cincinnati Enquirer
  • Recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Mid-size Companies in 2021
  • Medpace ranks amongst top CROs for site ratings across all 10 important attributes including CRA training, preparation & organization, accessibility of staff, open communication, and ensuring timely drug availability
  • Continually recognized with CRO Leadership Awards from Life Science Leader magazine based on expertise, quality, capabilities, reliability, and compatibility
  • Ranked in the top 10 on the 2021 LinkedIn Top Companies list in Cincinnati
